title: Search in rotated sorted array-II
statementHtml: Given an integer array nums, sorted in ascending order (may contain duplicate values) and a target value k. Now the array is rotated at some pivot point unknown to you. Return True if k is present and otherwise, return False.
examples:
Input : nums = [7, 8, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6], k = 3

Output: True

Explanation: The element 3 is present in the array. So, the answer is True.

Input : nums = [7, 8, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6], k = 10

Output: False

Explanation:The element 10 is not present in the array. So, the answer is False.
constraintsHtml:
•   1 <= nums.length <= 104
  •   -104 <= nums[i] <= 104
  •   nums is guaranteed to be rotated at some pivot.
  •   -104 <= k <= 104
